topic: Why Clothes Come Out of the Washer Soaking Wet
notes: Keep troubleshooting model-agnostic. Cover load imbalance/overloading, cycle selection, spin speed, leveling and drainage as possibilities, but do not tell readers to disassemble or service the washer. Defer to the owner manual for capacity, cycle selection and service steps. If standing water, repeated spin failure, unusual noise or a persistent fault remains, recommend manufacturer support or qualified service.
